does: Prepares the roll screen of a dialogue roll: resets the gui::VMRoll, fills the title of the check (the ability, or the skill and its ability through eoc::stats::GetSkillAbility) and the character it is for.

evidence.says: calls gui::VMRoll::ResetData, GetAbilityCheckString and eoc::stats::GetSkillAbility, builds translated argument strings, clears and refills a collection of the view model, and defers property changes
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a dialogue was on (segments 4, 16, 31, 32), 5 times from 1 place in the UI data-context code
